descriptor: Cloud platform with a public status page

voice.summary: Northwind Cloud sounds like a calm incident commander: clear on what is affected, steady in tone and never defensive. It posts time, scope and next update every time.
dos: State what is affected, when and what happens next
Use plain status words such as 'Operational' and 'Degraded'
donts: Use marketing tone on a status page
Promise a fix time you cannot meet

boilerplate: Northwind Cloud is a cloud infrastructure provider that publishes real-time service status, 90-day uptime history and incident reports for customers and engineers.

microcopy.success: Subscribed. We will email you about incidents.
microcopy.error: Enter a valid email address to subscribe.

logo.note: A cloud is the shape that says cloud infrastructure to every engineer.
